population.span: Community-dwelling adults at least 70 years of age with no history of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive atorvastatin at a dose of 40 mg once daily or identical placebo.

endpoint.span: a composite of death from cardiovascular causes, nonfatal myocardial infarction or stroke, or coronary revascularization (to assess effects on major cardiovascular events)

treatment_strategy.span: randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive atorvastatin at a dose of 40 mg once daily or identical placebo.

follow_up.span: After a median of 5.9 years, a primary cardiovascular event had occurred

absent_reason.analysis_set: No held source states the analysis population used for this estimate. A hierarchical testing plan does not establish intention-to-treat analysis.

served_mismatch: The served HR and confidence interval match the reported cardiovascular composite. The served intention-to-treat analysis-set claim is not established by the held sources. The source reports HR, matching served_row.scale and served_estimand, whereas served_outcome.estimand specifies RR.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The randomized entry population consists of adults at least 70 years old without cardiovascular disease; diabetes and dementia were also excluded.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Community-dwelling adults at least 70 years of age with no history of cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia were randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to receive atorvastatin at a dose of 40 mg once daily or identical placebo.

notes: All bound spans come from the held abstract. The estimate concerns the cardiovascular composite at a median of 5.9 years, not the separate disability-free survival composite.
